correctness.rationale: All lifted generating vertices are exposed within their unique color face. Squared distance of any pair is |S delta T|+2*1_(colors different), at most d+2. Equality forces colors distinct and S,T complementary. A set and its complement are both upper ideals if and only if each is a union of comparability components. The count a(I)=e(P|I)e(P|I^c) counts extensions with suffix I; empty/full contribute k(k-1) pairs, proper complementary I contribute half sum squares. For a chain the only farthest pair is empty/full. Independently enumerated antichains d=2..5 and recovered diameter pair counts 3,42,744,18600.
